title: Dynamic SQL executed from text (mysql) — review required
description: A mysql routine executes a statement built as text. If any part of that text is untrusted input, the statement structure is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the execution; the reviewer confirms the text is constant or parameterized.
remediation: Use a constant statement with ? placeholders and EXECUTE USING, and keep input out of the statement text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

tests.line: PREPARE stmt FROM CONCAT('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ', @id);
# audit: PREPARE stmt FROM CONCAT('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ', @id); present
PREPARE stmt FROM 'SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?';
# verified: PREPARE stmt FROM 'SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?';
